summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I found (read-only audit, no changes made)  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `/api/watchlist` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → SQLite.  - **Backend is correctly scoped.** Every watchlist route requires a valid session cookie, resolves the real `user_id` from the session table (not a client-supplied header), and every query filters `WHERE user_id = ?`. `user_id` is `NOT NULL` in the schema. No default/guest/anonymous watchlist exists anywhere in the code. - **No localStorage/anonymous fallback** in the clien
